text: We tested weak-to-strong generalization by reweighting weak labels according to the frozen strong model's margin, with a margin temperature of 0.5, training qwen2.5-7b on labels from gpt2-small. The weak supervisor reaches 0.6 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling is 0.82; the strong model trained on reweighted weak labels reaches a transfer accuracy of 0.78 (SE 0.03), corresponding to a PGR of 0.81 with a standard error of 0.14, against a baseline PGR of 0.26. Importantly, this comes from a single seed (num_seeds = 1), so the reported standard errors rest on one run and give no information about seed-to-seed variability; no baseline standard error is provided, so the comparison with 0.26 cannot be assessed against two standard errors of the baseline. The direction is encouraging, but the evidence here is preliminary and would need replication across several seeds before the margin-reweighting method could be credited with a genuine gain.
